title.zh: 卷326 列傳一百十三 开泰 阿尔泰 桂林 温福
title.en: Volume 326 Biographies 113: Kai Tai, A Er Tai, Gui Lin, Wen Fu
title.raw: 卷326 列傳一百十三 开泰 阿尔泰 桂林 温福

sentences.zh: =開泰=開泰，烏雅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Kai Tai, of the Uya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Kai Tai, of the Uya clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年進士，改庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 2 he passed the metropolitan examination, was made a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi in Yongzheng 2, entered the Hanlin as a probationer, and was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷侍講。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to expositor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to expositor.

sentences.zh: 上御門，開泰未入侍班，黜令乾清門行走。

translations.literal: When the emperor held court at the Gate, Kai Tai had not entered the attendance roster and was dismissed to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor held audience at the Gate, Kai Tai had failed to take his place in the attendance roster and was demoted to duty at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 十三年，复編修。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was restored as compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was reappointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，遷國子監司業。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was transferred to vice-director of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he was promoted to vice-director of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷祭酒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to chancellor of the Academy.

sentences.zh: 督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: He supervised the educational administration of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 再遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was next promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 三遷兵部侍郎，仍留學政任。

translations.literal: A third transfer made him vice minister of War, while he retained his post as educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was then promoted to vice minister of War but kept his educational commission.

sentences.zh: 十年，授湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「社倉較常平尤近於民，而弊亦易滋。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Community granaries are even closer to the people than ever-normal granaries, yet abuses also arise more easily.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial stating: "Community granaries lie even closer to the people than ever-normal granaries, but malfeasance also spreads more easily.

sentences.zh: 湖北社倉穀麥五十二萬石有奇，散在諸鄉，恐多虧缺。

translations.literal: Hubei's community granaries hold more than five hundred twenty thousand piculs of grain, scattered through the townships, and I fear much may be deficient.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei's community granaries hold over five hundred twenty thousand piculs of grain and wheat, dispersed among the townships, and I fear many shortfalls.

sentences.zh: 應飭道府按部所至，便宜抽驗。

translations.literal: Circuit intendants and prefects should be ordered to conduct spot inspections wherever their tours take them.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit and prefectural officials should be instructed to conduct spot checks wherever their inspections take them.

sentences.zh: 」調江西。

translations.literal: " He was transferred to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: " He was then transferred to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十三年，又調湖南。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred again to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「戶部諮各省常平倉穀，以雍正舊額為準。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Board of Revenue has inquired of each province regarding ever-normal granary grain, taking the Yongzheng quota as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Board of Revenue has asked each province to report on ever-normal granary stocks, using the Yongzheng quota as the standard.

sentences.zh: 湖南溢額穀五十五萬餘石，令糶價儲庫。

translations.literal: Hunan has a surplus of more than five hundred fifty thousand piculs and has been ordered to sell the surplus and deposit the proceeds in the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's surplus exceeds five hundred fifty thousand piculs, and the province has been ordered to sell it and deposit the proceeds in the treasury.

sentences.zh: 臣維雍正舊額七十餘萬石。

translations.literal: Your servant maintains that the Yongzheng quota was more than seven hundred thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: I maintain that the Yongzheng quota was over seven hundred thousand piculs.

sentences.zh: 湖南夙稱產米，乾隆二年至八年，諸省赴湖南購米，先後計百七十五萬有奇。

translations.literal: Hunan has long been famed for rice production; from Qianlong 2 to 8 other provinces came to Hunan to purchase rice, totaling in all more than one million seven hundred fifty thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan has long been known as a rice-producing region; from Qianlong 2 through 8 other provinces purchased rice there, totaling more than one million seven hundred fifty thousand piculs.

sentences.zh: 中間又撥運福建、江蘇。

translations.literal: In between, grain was also allocated and shipped to Fujian and Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the meantime grain was also requisitioned and shipped to Fujian and Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 若盡糶溢額之穀，遇本省需用或鄰疆告糴，必致倉儲缺額，買補不易。

translations.literal: If all the surplus grain is sold off, when this province needs grain or neighboring regions request relief, granary quotas will fall short and replenishment will be difficult.
translations.idiomatic: If all surplus grain is sold, whenever the province itself needs grain or neighboring regions request relief, stores will fall below quota and be hard to replenish.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，以留心積貯嘉之。

translations.literal: " When the memorial reached the throne, he was praised for his attention to accumulation and storage.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor commended him for his care in maintaining grain reserves.

sentences.zh: 十五年，有壽掄元者，自言南河同知，赴湖南採木，布政使孫灝諭永州府為料理。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year a man named Shou Lunyuan claimed to be sub-prefect of the Southern Rivers, came to Hunan to procure timber, and the provincial treasurer Sun Hao instructed Yongzhou prefecture to arrange matters for him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year a man named Shou Lunyuan claimed to be sub-prefect of the Southern Rivers and came to Hunan to procure timber; provincial treasurer Sun Hao instructed Yongzhou prefecture to assist him.

sentences.zh: 尋得其詐偽狀，開泰以聞，但言灝殊為未諳。

translations.literal: Soon his fraud was discovered; Kai Tai reported it but only said that Hao had been quite uninformed.
translations.idiomatic: His imposture was soon uncovered; Kai Tai reported it to the throne but merely said that Hao had been quite naive.

sentences.zh: 上以灝瞻徇，何得但言未諳，知為開泰門生，斥其徇庇，下吏部嚴議，議奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: The emperor said Hao had shown favoritism—how could one merely say he was uninformed?—and knowing him to be Kai Tai's protégé, rebuked Kai Tai for partiality, referred the case to the Board of Civil Appointments for severe deliberation, which recommended dismissal from office, but the emperor ordered him retained in his post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Hao had shown favoritism and asked how Kai Tai could dismiss it as mere ignorance; learning that Hao was Kai Tai's protégé, he rebuked Kai Tai for shielding him. The Board of Civil Appointments recommended stripping his rank, but the emperor allowed him to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 尋調貴州。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十八年，疏言：「古州募軍屯田，戶上田六畝，中田八畝，下田十畝。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he memorialized: "At Guzhou recruited soldiers farm garrison lands: six mu per household on upper fields, eight on middle fields, ten on lower fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he memorialized: "At Guzhou recruited soldiers farm garrison lands on a graded basis—six mu per household on top-grade fields, eight on middle-grade, ten on lower-grade.

sentences.zh: 今食指日多，生計艱難，請準屯戶入伍充兵。

translations.literal: Now mouths to feed grow daily and livelihoods are hard; I request permission for garrison households to enlist as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: As dependents multiply and livelihoods grow harder, I ask that garrison households be allowed to enlist as regular troops.

sentences.zh: 」許之。

translations.literal: " Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 擢湖廣總督，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: He was promoted governor-general of Huguang and given the additional title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor-general of Huguang and given the additional title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十年，調四川。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 金川土司莎羅奔與革布什咱土司色楞敦多布初為婚媾，繼乃相怨構兵。

translations.literal: Jinchuan chieftain Slob Dpon and Gebushizan chieftain Selenduobu were at first allied by marriage, but later bore grudges and raised troops against each other.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchuan chieftain Slob Dpon and Gebushizan chieftain Selenduobu were initially linked by marriage, but later fell out and went to war.

sentences.zh: 旁近綽斯甲布、鄂克什、雜穀、巴旺、丹壩、明正、章谷、小金川諸土司皆不直莎羅奔。

translations.literal: Neighboring chieftains of Zhuosijia, Eke Shi, Zagu, Bawang, Danba, Mingzheng, Zhanggu, and Lesser Jinchuan all sided against Slob Dpon.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring chieftains of Zhuosijia, Eke Shi, Zagu, Bawang, Danba, Mingzheng, Zhanggu, and Lesser Jinchuan all took sides against Slob Dpon.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，莎羅奔攻吉地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Slob Dpon attacked Jidi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Slob Dpon attacked Jidi.

sentences.zh: 吉地，色楞敦多布所居寨也。

translations.literal: Jidi was the stockade where Selenduobu resided.
translations.idiomatic: Jidi was the stockade where Selenduobu lived.

sentences.zh: 開泰與提督岳鍾琪檄游擊楊青、都司夏尚德等率兵分屯章谷、泰宁，令鄂克什、雜穀援革布什咱，攻金川，莎羅奔引退。

translations.literal: Kai Tai and provincial commander-in-chief Yue Zhongqi ordered battalion commander Yang Qing, brigade commander Xia Shangde, and others to lead troops and garrison separately at Zhanggu and Taining, directed Eke Shi and Zagu to aid Gebushizan and attack Jinchuan, and Slob Dpon withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Kai Tai and provincial commander Yue Zhongqi ordered battalion commander Yang Qing, brigade commander Xia Shangde, and others to station troops at Zhanggu and Taining, sent Eke Shi and Zagu to aid Gebushizan against Jinchuan, and Slob Dpon retreated.

sentences.zh: 尋復攻破吉地，色楞敦多布走泰宁求援，開泰复檄諸土司出兵助之，調雜穀土練千人分屯丹壩、章谷、泰宁，發黎、雅、峨邊兵屯打箭爐，諭郎卡撤兵。

translations.literal: Soon Jidi was again taken; Selenduobu fled to Taining to seek aid. Kai Tai again ordered the chieftains to send troops to help, mobilized a thousand Zagu native militia to garrison separately at Danba, Zhanggu, and Taining, sent troops from Li, Ya, and Ebian to garrison Dajianlu, and instructed Lang Ka to withdraw his forces.
translations.idiomatic: Jidi fell again soon afterward; Selenduobu fled to Taining for help. Kai Tai again ordered the chieftains to send troops, deployed a thousand Zagu militiamen at Danba, Zhanggu, and Taining, posted troops from Li, Ya, and Ebian at Dajianlu, and instructed Lang Ka to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 郎卡，莎羅奔從子，為副酋，主兵事者也。

translations.literal: Lang Ka was Slob Dpon's nephew, served as deputy chieftain, and directed military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Lang Ka was Slob Dpon's nephew, served as deputy chieftain, and directed military affairs.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上謂：「番目相攻，於打箭爐何與？

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor said: "When native chiefs fight one another, what has that to do with Dajianlu?
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, the emperor said: "When native chiefs fight among themselves, what business is that of Dajianlu?

sentences.zh: 」疑郎卡擾邊，命開泰具實覆奏。

translations.literal: " Suspecting Lang Ka of disturbing the border, he ordered Kai Tai to report the facts in full.
translations.idiomatic: " Suspecting Lang Ka of harassing the frontier, he ordered Kai Tai to submit a full factual report.

sentences.zh: 開泰尋疏報章谷、巴旺土兵擊敗金川，莎羅奔焚吉地走，盡复革布什咱境，留綽斯甲布、明正兩土司兵分守之，使色楞敦多布歸寨。

translations.literal: Kai Tai soon memorialized that Zhanggu and Bawang native troops had defeated Jinchuan; Slob Dpon burned Jidi and fled; Gebushizan territory was fully recovered; troops of the Zhuosijia and Mingzheng chieftains were left to garrison it in separate detachments; and Selenduobu was restored to his stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Kai Tai soon reported that Zhanggu and Bawang forces had defeated Jinchuan; Slob Dpon burned Jidi and fled; Gebushizan territory was fully recovered; Zhuosijia and Mingzheng troops were left to garrison it; and Selenduobu was restored to his stockade.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「番民挾仇攻擊，不必繩以內地官法。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "When native tribesmen attack one another out of vendetta, there is no need to bind them with the statutes of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "When native tribesmen attack one another over old grudges, there is no need to apply the laws of the interior provinces.

sentences.zh: 宜以番攻番，處以靜鎮。

translations.literal: It is fitting to let natives fight natives and handle matters with quiet restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Let natives fight natives and handle the matter with calm restraint.

sentences.zh: 」旋加太子太保。

translations.literal: " He was soon given the additional title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " He was soon given the additional title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，松潘鎮總兵楊朝棟入覲，開泰與鍾琪奏朝棟衰老，難期勝任。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Songpan garrison commander Yang Chaodong came to audience; Kai Tai and Zhongqi memorialized that Chaodong was aged and could hardly be expected to perform his duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Songpan garrison commander Yang Chaodong came to court; Kai Tai and Zhongqi reported that he was too old to be relied upon for duty.

sentences.zh: 上責開泰何以不先奏，下吏部議，奪官，命仍留任。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Kai Tai for not having reported this earlier, referred the case to the Board of Civil Appointments, which recommended stripping his rank, but the emperor ordered him retained in his post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Kai Tai for not having reported this sooner; the Board recommended stripping his rank, but the emperor allowed him to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，莎羅奔死，郎卡應襲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Slob Dpon died and Lang Ka was due to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Slob Dpon died and Lang Ka was due to inherit the chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 例，土司承襲，鄰封諸土司具結。

translations.literal: By precedent, when a native chieftain succeeds, neighboring chieftains submit joint attestations.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when a native chieftain succeeds, neighboring chieftains must submit joint attestations.

sentences.zh: 開泰以郎卡與諸土司皆不協，令毋取結，疏聞，上許之，命嚴諭郎卡知恩守法。

translations.literal: Kai Tai, because Lang Ka was at odds with all the chieftains, ordered that no attestations be taken; when he reported this, the emperor approved and ordered Lang Ka sternly instructed to know gratitude and obey the law.
translations.idiomatic: Because Lang Ka was at odds with all the neighboring chieftains, Kai Tai waived the attestations; the emperor approved and ordered Lang Ka sternly reminded to show gratitude and obey the law.

sentences.zh: 未幾，郎卡侵丹壩，取所屬瑪讓，開泰檄綽斯甲布往援，使守備溫欽等赴金川詰責。

translations.literal: Before long Lang Ka invaded Danba and seized its dependency Marang; Kai Tai ordered Zhuosijia to go to its aid and sent garrison commandant Wen Qin and others to Jinchuan to reprimand him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Lang Ka invaded Danba and seized its dependency Marang; Kai Tai ordered Zhuosijia to relieve Danba and sent garrison commandant Wen Qin and others to Jinchuan to rebuke him.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「郎卡狼子野心，即使詰責伏罪，豈肯永守約束？

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Lang Ka has the heart of a wolf cub; even if rebuked and made to submit, how could he forever keep to his bonds?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Lang Ka is treacherous by nature; even if rebuked into submission, how could he be trusted to keep his word forever?

sentences.zh: 諸土司援兵既集，能協力剿除，分據其地，轉可相安；

translations.literal: If the chieftains' relief forces are already assembled and can join in exterminating him and divide his lands among themselves, peace may yet be secured;
translations.idiomatic: If the chieftains' relief forces are already assembled and can join to destroy him and divide his territory among themselves, the region may yet be pacified;

sentences.zh: 若諸部不能並力剿除，而郎卡怙惡不悛，亦非開泰、岳鍾琪四川綠營兵能任其事，應臨時奏請進止。

translations.literal: if the tribes cannot combine to exterminate him and Lang Ka persists in his evil without reform, neither Kai Tai nor Yue Zhongqi's Sichuan Green Standard troops can undertake the task—you should memorialize at the time for instructions on advancing or halting.
translations.idiomatic: if the tribes cannot combine to destroy him and Lang Ka persists in his wickedness, neither Kai Tai nor Yue Zhongqi's Sichuan Green Standard troops can handle the matter—you should memorialize when the time comes for instructions on how to proceed.

sentences.zh: 」二十八年六月，開泰奏九土司大舉擊破金川。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year Kai Tai memorialized that nine chieftains had launched a major campaign and broken Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year Kai Tai reported that nine chieftains had launched a major campaign and defeated Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 上聞郎卡使人詣成都，開泰許進謁，撫慰之，而陰令九土司進兵，諭曰：「郎卡於綽斯甲布等屢肆欺凌，眾土司合力報復。

translations.literal: The emperor learned that Lang Ka had sent envoys to Chengdu; Kai Tai allowed them audience and comforted them, while secretly ordering the nine chieftains to advance. He instructed: "Lang Ka has repeatedly bullied Zhuosijia and the others; the chieftains are joining forces in reprisal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor learned that Lang Ka had sent envoys to Chengdu; Kai Tai received them and offered reassurance while secretly ordering the nine chieftains to advance. He instructed: "Lang Ka has repeatedly bullied Zhuosijia and others; the chieftains are joining forces to retaliate.

sentences.zh: 開泰既聞其事，惟應明白宣示，諭令悉銳往攻；

translations.literal: Now that Kai Tai has heard of this, he should only declare openly and order them to attack with full force;
translations.idiomatic: Once Kai Tai heard of this, he should have declared openly and ordered them to attack with full force;

sentences.zh: 而於郎卡來人嚴為拒絕，且諭以爾結怨鄰境，誰肯甘心？

translations.literal: and toward Lang Ka's envoys he should have been stern in refusal, telling them: You have made enemies of your neighbors—who will bear this gladly?
translations.idiomatic: and toward Lang Ka's envoys he should have refused them firmly, saying: You have made enemies of your neighbors—who will bear that gladly?

sentences.zh: 斷不能曲為庇護。

translations.literal: I certainly cannot bend the rules to shield you.
translations.idiomatic: I certainly cannot bend the rules to shield you.

sentences.zh: 如此，則郎卡既不敢逞強，綽斯甲布等亦可洩忿。

translations.literal: In this way Lang Ka would not dare show his strength, and Zhuosijia and the others could also vent their anger.
translations.idiomatic: That way Lang Ka would not dare act aggressively, and Zhuosijia and the others could also vent their grievances.

sentences.zh: 乃既用譎以籠絡郎卡，又隱為各土司援助，郎卡素狡黠，豈能掩其耳目？

translations.literal: Yet he used deceit to win Lang Ka over while secretly aiding the chieftains—Lang Ka has always been cunning; how could his eyes and ears be hoodwinked?
translations.idiomatic: Instead he used deceit to win Lang Ka over while secretly aiding the chieftains—Lang Ka has always been cunning; how could he fail to see through it?

sentences.zh: 殊非駕馭邊夷之道。

translations.literal: This is far from the way to manage frontier tribes.
translations.idiomatic: This is far from the proper way to manage frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 」命奪官，以頭等侍衛赴伊犁辦事。

translations.literal: " He was ordered stripped of rank and sent to Yili as a first-class bodyguard on assignment.
translations.idiomatic: " He was stripped of rank and sent to Yili as a first-class imperial bodyguard on assignment.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: =阿爾泰=阿爾泰，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Aertai, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai, of the Irgen Gioro clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，以副榜貢生授宗人府筆帖式。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng period, as a tribute student from the supplementary list he was appointed clerk of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign, as a tribute student from the supplementary list he was appointed a clerk of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，屢遷至山東巡撫。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong period he was repeatedly transferred until he became governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong he rose through repeated promotions until he became governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以山東產山綢，疏請令民間就山坡隙地廣植桲欏，免其昇科。

translations.literal: Because Shandong produces mountain silk, he memorialized requesting that the people be allowed to plant mulberry extensively on hillside gaps and be exempted from added land tax.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shandong produces mountain silk, he memorialized asking that people be allowed to plant mulberry widely on hillside plots and be exempted from added land tax.

sentences.zh: 歲大水，阿爾泰先後濬兗州、沂州支渠三十有九，曹州、單縣順堤河二百餘裡；

translations.literal: In a year of great flood, Aertai successively dredged thirty-nine branch canals in Yanzhou and Yizhou and more than two hundred li of embankment-following rivers in Caozhou and Shan County;
translations.idiomatic: In a year of severe flooding, Aertai dredged thirty-nine branch canals in Yanzhou and Yizhou and more than two hundred li of embankment channels in Caozhou and Shan County;

sentences.zh: 培南旺、蜀山湖民埝；

translations.literal: he built up the civilian dikes at Nanwang and Shushan Lake;
translations.idiomatic: he strengthened civilian dikes at Nanwang and Shushan Lake;

sentences.zh: 導章丘珍珠、麻塘二泉，新城五龍河溉民田；

translations.literal: he channeled the Zhenzhu and Matang springs of Zhangqiu and the Wulong River of Xincheng to irrigate civilian fields;
translations.idiomatic: he channeled the Zhenzhu and Matang springs of Zhangqiu and the Wulong River of Xincheng to irrigate farmland;

sentences.zh: 並及高苑、博興、惠民諸縣近水地，皆令蓺稻。

translations.literal: and in Gaoyuan, Boxing, Huimin, and other counties with nearby water he ordered rice planted throughout.
translations.idiomatic: and in Gaoyuan, Boxing, Huimin, and other water-adjacent counties he ordered rice cultivation throughout.

sentences.zh: 築洸河堤至於馬場湖，以衛濟寧州城，析白馬湖引入獨山湖以疏泗水，開汶上稻田數百頃。

translations.literal: He built Guang River dikes as far as Machang Lake to protect Jining prefectural city, diverted Baima Lake into Dushan Lake to drain the Si River, and opened several hundred qing of paddy fields in Wenshang.
translations.idiomatic: He built Guang River dikes as far as Machang Lake to protect Jining city, diverted Baima Lake into Dushan Lake to relieve the Si River, and opened several hundred qing of paddy in Wenshang.

sentences.zh: 濟東諸州縣瀕徒駭、馬頰兩河，支流相貫注，及哨馬營、四女寺支河，皆次第疏治。

translations.literal: In the eastern Ji prefectures and counties along the Tuhai and Majia rivers, where tributaries interlinked, as well as the branch rivers at Shaomaying and Sinü Temple, dredging was carried out in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: In eastern Ji prefectures along the Tuhai and Majia rivers, where tributaries interlinked, and at branch rivers such as Shaomaying and Sinü Temple, dredging was carried out in turn.

sentences.zh: 濬衛河自德州至於館陶凡三百餘裡。

translations.literal: He dredged the Wei River from Dezhou to Guantao, more than three hundred li in all.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged more than three hundred li of the Wei River from Dezhou to Guantao.

sentences.zh: 洩壽張積水自沙、趙二河入運，洩東平積水入會泉、大清諸河，洩濟南、東昌諸州縣積水。

translations.literal: He drained Shouzhang's accumulated water through the Sha and Zhao rivers into the Grand Canal, drained Dongping's accumulated water into the Huiquan and Daqing rivers, and drained accumulated water in Jinan, Dongchang, and other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He drained Shouzhang's floodwater through the Sha and Zhao rivers into the Grand Canal, Dongping's into the Huiquan and Daqing rivers, and floodwater across Jinan, Dongchang, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 開支河三十餘，循官道為壕，引水自壕入支河，自支河入徒駭、大清諸河。

translations.literal: He opened more than thirty branch rivers, dug ditches along the official roads, led water from the ditches into branch rivers, and from branch rivers into the Tuhai, Daqing, and other rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He opened more than thirty branch channels, dug ditches along official roads, and led water from ditches into branch rivers and then into the Tuhai, Daqing, and other rivers.

sentences.zh: 漳、汶合流，開引河，增子埝，以防盛漲。

translations.literal: Where the Zhang and Wen rivers joined, he opened diversion channels and added subsidiary dikes against sudden floods.
translations.idiomatic: Where the Zhang and Wen rivers met, he opened diversion channels and added subsidiary dikes against sudden floods.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰撫山東七年，治水利有績，擢四川總督，加太子太保。

translations.literal: Aertai governed Shandong for seven years with achievements in water control and was promoted governor-general of Sichuan with the additional title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After seven years governing Shandong with notable achievements in water control, Aertai was promoted to governor-general of Sichuan and given the additional title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰至四川，議平治道路：陸道北訖廣元，西達松潘，東抵夔州，護其傾欹，補其缺落，兼葺大渡河瀘定橋；

translations.literal: When Aertai reached Sichuan he proposed leveling and repairing roads: overland routes north to Guangyuan, west to Songpan, and east to Kuizhou, shoring up tilting sections and filling gaps, and also repairing the Luding Bridge on the Dadu River;
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Sichuan, Aertai proposed repairing the road network: overland routes north to Guangyuan, west to Songpan, and east to Kuizhou, shoring up tilting sections and filling gaps, and also repairing the Luding Bridge on the Dadu River;

sentences.zh: 水道自萬縣入湖廣境，鑿治險灘凡一百有奇。

translations.literal: the water route from Wan County into Huguang territory had more than a hundred dangerous shoals cut and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: along the water route from Wan County into Huguang, more than a hundred dangerous shoals were cleared.

sentences.zh: 議以牧廠餘地招佃為田。

translations.literal: He proposed recruiting tenants to farm leftover pasture lands.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed recruiting tenants to farm unused pasture lands.

sentences.zh: 議置義倉，捐穀千餘石以倡。

translations.literal: He proposed establishing charity granaries and donated more than a thousand piculs of grain to set an example.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed establishing charity granaries and donated more than a thousand piculs of grain to lead by example.

sentences.zh: 議開南川金佛山磺礦。

translations.literal: He proposed opening the sulfur mines at Jinfo Mountain in Nanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed opening the sulfur mines at Jinfo Mountain in Nanchuan.

sentences.zh: 議築都江大堰。

translations.literal: He proposed building the great Dujiangyan irrigation works.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed repairing the great Dujiangyan irrigation works.

sentences.zh: 議松潘、雜穀、打箭爐三廳置倉儲麥稞，備邊儲。

translations.literal: He proposed that the three frontier offices of Songpan, Zagu, and Dajianlu establish granaries for barley and grain to prepare border reserves.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that the frontier offices of Songpan, Zagu, and Dajianlu establish granaries for barley and grain as border reserves.

sentences.zh: 上皆從其請。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all his requests.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all his proposals.

sentences.zh: 初，徵金川，以頭人郎卡出降，罷兵。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the campaign against Jinchuan, when chieftain Lang Ka submitted, troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during the campaign against Jinchuan, when chieftain Lang Ka surrendered, the army was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，復為亂，掠丹壩、巴旺。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he rebelled again and raided Danba and Bawang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he rebelled again and raided Danba and Bawang.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰策以番攻番，令旁近綽斯甲布諸土司攻之。

translations.literal: Aertai planned to let natives fight natives and ordered neighboring Zhuosijia and other chieftains to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai adopted the strategy of letting natives fight natives and ordered neighboring Zhuosijia and other chieftains to attack him.

sentences.zh: 秋出行邊，至雜穀腦。

translations.literal: In autumn he went on a frontier tour as far as Zagunao.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he toured the frontier as far as Zagunao.

sentences.zh: 郎卡使請還所侵丹壩碉卡。

translations.literal: Lang Ka sent envoys requesting return of the Danba blockhouses he had seized.
translations.idiomatic: Lang Ka sent envoys asking that the Danba blockhouses he had seized be returned.

sentences.zh: 復與提督董天弼進至康巴達，郎卡出謁，阿爾泰許如所請，並畀以新印。

translations.literal: He advanced again with provincial commander Dong Tianbi to Kangbada; Lang Ka came out to pay his respects; Aertai granted his request and also gave him a new seal.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced again with provincial commander Dong Tianbi to Kangbada; Lang Ka came out to pay his respects; Aertai granted his request and presented him with a new seal.

sentences.zh: 疏聞，上戒毋遷就苟安。

translations.literal: When he reported this, the emperor warned him not to compromise for the sake of temporary peace.
translations.idiomatic: When he reported this, the emperor warned him not to settle for a temporary peace at the cost of principle.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，小金川頭人僧格桑掠鄂克什，阿爾泰赴達木巴宗，僧格桑出謁，還侵地。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Senggesang raided Eke Shi; Aertai went to Damubazong; Senggesang came out to pay his respects and returned the seized territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Senggesang raided Eke Shi; Aertai went to Damubazong; Senggesang came out to pay his respects and returned the seized lands.

sentences.zh: 尋授武英殿大學士，仍領總督。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed grand secretary of the Hall of Military Glory while still retaining the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed grand secretary of the Hall of Military Glory while continuing as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，召還京，入閣治事。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was recalled to the capital to conduct affairs in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was recalled to the capital to serve in the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 既，復令出領總督。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was again ordered out to resume the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was again sent out to resume the governorship.

sentences.zh: 金川頭人索諾木攻革布什咱，僧格桑亦圍達木巴宗，侵明正土司。

translations.literal: Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu attacked Gebushizan; Senggesang also besieged Damubazong and invaded the Mingzheng chieftaincy.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu attacked Gebushizan; Senggesang also besieged Damubazong and invaded the Mingzheng chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰疏言：「兩金川相比，如議出師，需兵既多，糜餉亦鉅。

translations.literal: Aertai memorialized: "The two Jinchuans adjoin one another; if a campaign is proposed, many troops will be needed and provisions will be enormous.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai memorialized: "The two Jinchuans border each other; if a campaign is proposed, it will require large forces and enormous supplies.

sentences.zh: 茲令董天弼臨之以兵，仍使游擊宋元俊宣諭索諾木。

translations.literal: Now order Dong Tianbi to press him with troops, and still send battalion commander Song Yuanjun to proclaim and instruct Suonuomu.
translations.idiomatic: I now order Dong Tianbi to press him with troops while battalion commander Song Yuanjun is sent to proclaim the imperial will to Suonuomu.

sentences.zh: 」上責阿爾泰議非是，決策用兵，令定邊右副將軍溫福視師，佐以侍郎桂林，諭斥阿爾泰掩飾偷安，奪大學士、總督，留軍治餉，以桂林代為總督。

translations.literal: " The emperor rebuked Aertai's proposal as wrong, decided on military action, ordered Pacification Commissioner on the Right Wen Fu to oversee the army with Vice Minister Guilin as assistant, rebuked Aertai for concealment and seeking ease, stripped him of grand secretary and governor-general, kept him with the army to manage supplies, and made Guilin governor in his place.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor rejected Aertai's proposal, decided to use force, appointed Pacification Commissioner on the Right Wen Fu to command the campaign with Vice Minister Guilin as his deputy, rebuked Aertai for covering up problems and seeking an easy peace, stripped him of his grand secretary and governor-general posts, kept him with the army to manage supplies, and replaced him with Guilin as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 師克約咱，上以阿爾泰鑄大砲利軍行，予散秩大臣銜。

translations.literal: When the army took Yozai, the emperor, because Aertai's cast cannon had aided the march, granted him the rank of minister without portfolio.
translations.idiomatic: When the army captured Yozai, the emperor credited Aertai's cast cannon with aiding the campaign and granted him minister-without-portfolio rank.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，與總兵宋元俊劾桂林覆軍諱敗，上為罷桂林，即命阿爾泰攝總督。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he and regional commander Song Yuanjun impeached Guilin for destroying the army and concealing defeat; the emperor dismissed Guilin and immediately ordered Aertai to act as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he and regional commander Song Yuanjun impeached Guilin for annihilating his force and concealing defeat; the emperor dismissed Guilin and immediately had Aertai act as governor.

sentences.zh: 俄移督湖廣。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to govern Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to govern Huguang.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰疏言：「各路轉餉，當招商承運。

translations.literal: Aertai memorialized: "For supply transport on all routes, merchants should be recruited to undertake carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai memorialized: "Supply transport on all routes should be contracted to merchants.

sentences.zh: 西路去內地近，南路山險途長，商不肯應募，當增運值。

translations.literal: The western route is close to the interior; the southern route is mountainous, dangerous, and long, and merchants will not answer the call—transport fees should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: The western route lies close to the interior, but the southern route is mountainous, dangerous, and long, and merchants will not volunteer—transport fees must be raised.

sentences.zh: 火藥已運罄，當令雲南、陝西協助。

translations.literal: Gunpowder has already been exhausted in transport; Yunnan and Shaanxi should be ordered to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Gunpowder supplies have run out in transit; Yunnan and Shaanxi should be ordered to assist.

sentences.zh: 」上謂：「阿爾泰專領轉餉，何不早籌畫？

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Aertai was put solely in charge of supply transport—why did he not plan early?
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Aertai was put solely in charge of supply transport—why did he not plan ahead?

sentences.zh: 今福隆安、阿桂皆至南路，始以一奏塞責。

translations.literal: Now that Fulunga and Agui have both reached the southern route, he submits one memorial merely to fulfill obligation.
translations.idiomatic: Only now that Fulunga and Agui have both reached the southern route does he submit a memorial merely to cover himself.

sentences.zh: 」命毋往湖廣，仍以散秩大臣留軍督餉。

translations.literal: " He was ordered not to go to Huguang but to remain with the army as minister without portfolio supervising supplies.
translations.idiomatic: " He was ordered not to proceed to Huguang but to remain with the army as minister without portfolio supervising supplies.

sentences.zh: 未幾，阿桂疏言軍至卡丫，無五日之糧；

translations.literal: Before long Agui memorialized that when the army reached Kayia it had less than five days' grain;
translations.idiomatic: Before long Agui reported that when the army reached Kayia it had less than five days' grain;

sentences.zh: 又言綽斯甲布轉餉將一月猶未至。

translations.literal: he also said Zhuosijia's supply transport had been nearly a month and still had not arrived.
translations.idiomatic: he also reported that Zhuosijia's supply transport had been underway for nearly a month without arriving.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰亦自陳請奪職從軍。

translations.literal: Aertai also volunteered to be stripped of rank and join the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai also volunteered to be stripped of rank and serve with the army.

sentences.zh: 上責其倚老負恩，始終不肯以國事為念，命逮問。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked him for relying on age and betraying favor, never willing to think of state affairs, and ordered his arrest for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked him for relying on his age and betraying imperial favor, never putting state affairs first, and ordered his arrest.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰初至四川，上以天壇立燈竿，下四川求楠木。

translations.literal: When Aertai first reached Sichuan, the emperor had lamp poles erected at the Temple of Heaven and ordered Sichuan to supply nanmu timber.
translations.idiomatic: When Aertai first reached Sichuan, the emperor had lamp poles erected at the Temple of Heaven and ordered Sichuan to supply nanmu timber.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰附運木材以進，言出養廉採獻。

translations.literal: Aertai sent timber along with his transport and said it was procured from his integrity stipend for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai forwarded timber with his transport and said it had been procured from his integrity stipend for presentation.

sentences.zh: 既乃私語人，謂他日且以此負累。

translations.literal: Afterward he privately told others that one day this would become a burden on him.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he privately told others that one day this would come back to haunt him.

sentences.zh: 語聞上，上心慊之。

translations.literal: When the words reached the emperor, his heart turned against him.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the emperor, he took offense.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔罪狀阿爾泰，猶及此事，斥為昧良飾詐。

translations.literal: At this time the edict listing Aertai's crimes still mentioned this matter and denounced him as ungrateful and deceitful.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the edict listing Aertai's crimes still cited this incident and denounced him as ungrateful and deceitful.

sentences.zh: 川東道托隆入見，發阿爾泰贓私，下繼任總督富勒渾嚴鞫。

translations.literal: Eastern Sichuan circuit intendant Tuo Long came to audience and exposed Aertai's corruption; the case was referred to succeeding governor Fulehun for strict interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Sichuan circuit intendant Tuo Long came to court and exposed Aertai's corruption; succeeding governor Fulehun was ordered to conduct a strict investigation.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，獄具，擬斬，上命賜自盡。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year the case was complete; decapitation was recommended, but the emperor ordered him granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year the case was concluded; decapitation was recommended, but the emperor ordered him granted suicide.

sentences.zh: =桂林=桂林，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人，兩廣總督鶴年子。

translations.literal: Guilin, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner and son of Huguang governor-general Henian.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin, of the Irgen Gioro clan, belonged to the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner and was the son of Huguang governor-general Henian.

sentences.zh: 桂林自廩生入貲為工部主事。

translations.literal: Guilin entered the Ministry of Works as a secretary by purchasing office from his status as a granary student.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin purchased office as a secretary in the Ministry of Works from his status as a granary student.

sentences.zh: 累遷山西按察使。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly transferred until he became Shanxi provincial judge.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through repeated promotions until he became provincial judge of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十六年三月，擢戶部侍郎、軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the third month of Qianlong 36 he was promoted vice minister of Revenue and assigned to the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Qianlong 36 he was promoted to vice minister of Revenue and assigned to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 九月，命佐定邊右副將軍溫福討金川。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was ordered to assist Pacification Commissioner on the Right Wen Fu in campaigning against Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was ordered to assist Pacification Commissioner on the Right Wen Fu against Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月，授四川總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he was appointed governor-general of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was appointed governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 小金川頭人在卡外投文餽土宜，桂林卻不受，檄罪狀其酋僧格桑。

translations.literal: A Lesser Jinchuan chieftain outside the pass submitted a document and presented local products; Guilin refused them and issued a proclamation listing the crimes of chieftain Senggesang.
translations.idiomatic: A Lesser Jinchuan chieftain outside the pass submitted a letter and local tribute; Guilin refused them and issued a proclamation listing chieftain Senggesang's crimes.

sentences.zh: 旋督兵收約咱，進克其東山梁大小碉五、石卡二十餘。

translations.literal: He soon directed troops to recover Yozai and advanced to take five large and small blockhouses and more than twenty stone forts on its eastern ridge.
translations.idiomatic: He soon directed troops to recover Yozai and advanced to capture five blockhouses and more than twenty stone forts on its eastern ridge.

sentences.zh: 疏請添調黔、陝兵五千益師，上許益陝、甘兵三千。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting five thousand additional troops from Guizhou and Shaanxi to reinforce the army; the emperor approved three thousand from Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting five thousand additional troops from Guizhou and Shaanxi; the emperor approved three thousand from Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 桂林旋督總兵宋元俊攻卡丫，進據墨爾多山梁。

translations.literal: Guilin soon directed regional commander Song Yuanjun to attack Kayia and advanced to occupy the Moerduo ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin soon directed regional commander Song Yuanjun to attack Kayia and advanced to occupy the Moerduo ridge.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其措置合宜，手詔謂：「無意中用汝，竟能得力。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his arrangements as fitting and wrote in his own hand: "I used you without intending to, yet you have proved effective.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his arrangements and wrote in his own hand: "I appointed you almost by chance, yet you have proved effective.

sentences.zh: 亦賴在軍機處半年，日耹朕訓也。

translations.literal: This also owes to half a year in the Grand Council, daily hearing my instruction."
translations.idiomatic: That also owes to half a year in the Grand Council, hearing my instruction every day."

sentences.zh: 三十七年，克卡丫，复破克郭松、甲木、噶爾金。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year Kayia was taken and Guosong, Jiamu, and Ga'erjin were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year Kayia was captured and Guosong, Jiamu, and Ga'erjin were recovered.

sentences.zh: 進克噶爾金後山梁，分兵攻東山梁，襲阿仰，自墨壟溝進取達烏圍。

translations.literal: He advanced to take the rear ridge of Ga'erjin, divided troops to attack the eastern ridge, raided Ayang, and from Molong Gully advanced to take Dawuwei.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to take the rear ridge of Ga'erjin, divided his forces to attack the eastern ridge, raided Ayang, and advanced from Molong Gully to take Dawuwei.

sentences.zh: 是時大金川酋索諾木攻陷革布什咱，屯兵其地。

translations.literal: At this time Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu had taken Gebushizan and stationed troops there.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu had overrun Gebushizan and stationed troops there.

sentences.zh: 桂林議乘索諾木兵力未備、革布什咱人心未定，與元俊分兵五道並進，並約將軍溫福合擊，密令革布什咱降酋旺勒丹等約其戚加琿爾為內應，遂收革布什咱寨落七十餘裡。

translations.literal: Guilin proposed that while Suonuomu's forces were unprepared and Gebushizan loyalties unsettled, he and Yuanjun should advance in five columns together, coordinate a joint strike with General Wen Fu, and secretly order surrendered Gebushizan chieftain Wangleidan and others to arrange with his kinsman Jiahuer as inside support; thus more than seventy li of Gebushizan stockades were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin proposed striking while Suonuomu's forces were unprepared and Gebushizan loyalties unsettled; he and Yuanjun advanced in five columns, coordinated with General Wen Fu for a joint attack, and secretly ordered surrendered chieftain Wangleidan to arrange inside support through his kinsman Jiahuer, recovering more than seventy li of Gebushizan stockades.

sentences.zh: 旋令元俊及守備陳定國率綽斯甲布土兵屯甲爾壟壩，進攻默資溝、吉地，斷其水道，進攻丹東。

translations.literal: He soon ordered Yuanjun and garrison commandant Chen Dingguo to lead Zhuosijia native troops to garrison at Jia'erlongba, attack Mozigou and Jidi, cut their water supply, and advance against Dandong.
translations.idiomatic: He soon ordered Yuanjun and garrison commandant Chen Dingguo to lead Zhuosijia troops to garrison at Jia'erlongba, attack Mozigou and Jidi, cut enemy water supplies, and advance on Dandong.

sentences.zh: 上獎桂林甚合機宜，促元俊乘勝深入取索諾木。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Guilin as very well timed and urged Yuanjun to press the victory deep and capture Suonuomu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Guilin's timing and urged Yuanjun to press the victory and capture Suonuomu.

sentences.zh: 桂林遣裨將自東山梁墨壟溝越嶺進攻，別遣兵出間道，自札哇窠山梁縋崖設伏師。

translations.literal: Guilin sent a deputy general from the eastern ridge over Molong Gully to attack across the pass, and separately sent troops by a hidden route to lower ropes from Zhawake Ridge and set an ambush.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin sent a deputy general from the eastern ridge over Molong Gully to attack across the pass, and separately sent troops by a hidden route to lower ropes from Zhawake Ridge and set an ambush.

sentences.zh: 既度東山梁墨壟溝，札哇窠伏兵亦起，賊敗竄，克大碉一、石卡二十一。

translations.literal: Once they crossed the eastern ridge and Molong Gully, the Zhawake ambush also rose; the rebels were defeated and fled; one large blockhouse and twenty-one stone forts were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Once they crossed the eastern ridge and Molong Gully, the Zhawake ambush struck as well; the rebels were routed; one large blockhouse and twenty-one stone forts were captured.

sentences.zh: 別遣參將常泰環攻黨哩，都司李天貴等攻沙沖，革布什咱頭人為內應，賊盡殲。

translations.literal: He separately sent colonel Chang Tai to encircle Dangli and brigade commander Li Tiangui and others to attack Shachong; Gebushizan chieftains served as inside support and the rebels were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: He separately sent colonel Chang Tai to encircle Dangli and brigade commander Li Tiangui and others to attack Shachong; Gebushizan chieftains served as inside allies and the rebels were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 黨哩、沙沖地並復。

translations.literal: The territories of Dangli and Shachong were also recovered.
translations.idiomatic: The territories of Dangli and Shachong were also recovered.

sentences.zh: 總兵英泰等復攻克達烏官寨。

translations.literal: Regional commander Ying Tai and others again took the Dawu official stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Ying Tai and others again captured the Dawu official stockade.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其功，賜御用玉韘。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his achievement and bestowed an imperial jade archer's ring.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his achievement and bestowed an imperial jade archer's ring.

sentences.zh: 再進攻克格烏巴桑及那隆山嶺。

translations.literal: Advancing again, he took Gewubasang and the Nalong mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing again, he captured Gewubasang and the Nalong ridge.

sentences.zh: 元俊別攻克丹東及覺拉喇嘛寺，誅賊渠三百、番眾百三十餘。

translations.literal: Yuanjun separately took Dandong and the Juela Lama Temple, executing three hundred rebel leaders and more than one hundred thirty tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjun separately captured Dandong and the Juela Lama Temple, executing three hundred rebel leaders and more than one hundred thirty tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 革布什咱地盡复，桂林檄定國將所調綽斯甲布兵駐界上聽調。

translations.literal: Gebushizan territory was fully recovered; Guilin ordered Dingguo to station the Zhuosijia troops he had mobilized on the border awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: Gebushizan territory was fully recovered; Guilin ordered Dingguo to station the Zhuosijia troops he had mobilized on the border awaiting orders.

sentences.zh: 上以革布什咱既复，正當乘勝進剿金川，攻其無備，責桂林失算。

translations.literal: The emperor said that with Gebushizan recovered, this was the moment to press the victory against Jinchuan and strike while they were unprepared, and rebuked Guilin for poor judgment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said that with Gebushizan recovered, Guilin should have pressed the victory against Jinchuan while the enemy was unprepared, and rebuked him for poor judgment.

sentences.zh: 桂林复督兵攻達烏東岸山梁，參將薛琮戰沒，琮驍將，深入糧盡。

translations.literal: Guilin again directed troops to attack the eastern bank ridge of Dawu; colonel Xue Cong was killed in battle—Cong was a fierce commander who had advanced deep and exhausted his grain.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin again directed troops against the eastern bank ridge of Dawu; colonel Xue Cong was killed in battle—a fierce commander who had advanced deep and run out of supplies.

sentences.zh: 桂林既失期不會師，又不以時遣援，軍盡覆，疏請治罪，述戰狀不敢盡。

translations.literal: Guilin had missed the rendezvous and failed to send relief in time; the army was annihilated; he memorialized requesting punishment and dared not report the battle in full.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin had missed the rendezvous and failed to send relief in time; the army was annihilated; he memorialized requesting punishment and did not dare report the full extent of the defeat.

sentences.zh: 元俊與散秩大臣阿爾泰劾其虛誑，並言桂林在卡丫建屋宇以居，迫屬僚供應，與副都統鐵保、提督汪騰龍等終日酣飲，諸將罕得見；

translations.literal: Yuanjun and minister without portfolio Aertai impeached him for falsehood, also saying Guilin had built houses at Kayia to live in, compelled subordinates to supply him, and with vice commander Tie Bao, provincial commander Wang Tenglong, and others drank all day while generals rarely saw him;
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjun and minister without portfolio Aertai impeached him for false reporting, also alleging that Guilin had built houses at Kayia for his residence, compelled subordinates to supply him, and with vice commander Tie Bao, provincial commander Wang Tenglong, and others drank all day while his generals rarely saw him;

sentences.zh: 密令騰龍畀總兵王萬邦白金五百，贖被掠官兵，希圖掩飾。

translations.literal: he secretly ordered Tenglong to give regional commander Wang Wanbang five hundred taels of silver to ransom captured officers and soldiers, hoping to cover up the matter.
translations.idiomatic: he secretly ordered Tenglong to give regional commander Wang Wanbang five hundred taels of silver to ransom captured officers and men, hoping to cover up the defeat.

sentences.zh: 上奪桂林職，命額駙、尚書、公福隆安馳往按治，尋奏所劾皆虛，惟官兵傷損不即察奏屬實；

translations.literal: The emperor stripped Guilin of office and ordered imperial son-in-law, minister, and duke Fulunga to hurry there to investigate; he soon reported that the impeachments were all false, except that failure to report promptly on casualties among officers and soldiers was true;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stripped Guilin of office and ordered imperial son-in-law, minister, and duke Fulunga to investigate on the spot; Fulunga soon reported that the charges were largely false, except that Guilin had failed to report promptly on casualties among officers and soldiers;

sentences.zh: 至贖被掠官兵，乃在軍戶部郎中汪承霈聞巴旺、布拉克底土兵歸失道，官兵告桂林，發白金五百交騰龍備賞，事為元俊構陷，請分別治罪。

translations.literal: as for ransoming captured troops, Revenue Bureau director Wang Chengpei with the army, learning that Bawang and Bulakedi native troops had lost their way on return, had officers and soldiers inform Guilin, who issued five hundred taels of silver to Tenglong for rewards—the matter was framed by Yuanjun; he requested separate punishments.
translations.idiomatic: as for ransoming captured troops, Revenue Bureau director Wang Chengpei with the army learned that Bawang and Bulakedi native troops had lost their way on return; officers and soldiers informed Guilin, who issued five hundred taels of silver to Tenglong for rewards—this was a frame-up by Yuanjun; he requested that punishments be assigned separately.

sentences.zh: 上以桂林在軍日親曲糱，止圖安逸，不能與士卒同甘苦，致北山梁傷損多兵，不得為無罪，命戍伊犁。

translations.literal: The emperor said that in camp Guilin personally attended to brewing, sought only ease, could not share hardship with the soldiers, and caused heavy casualties on the northern ridge—he could not be held guiltless—and ordered him exiled to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said that in camp Guilin personally attended to brewing, sought only comfort, could not share hardship with his soldiers, and caused heavy casualties on the northern ridge—he could not be held guiltless—and ordered him exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 三十八年七月，予三等侍衛銜，仍詣軍前督糧運。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirty-eighth year he was given third-class bodyguard rank and again sent to the front to supervise grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirty-eighth year he was given third-class bodyguard rank and again sent to the front to supervise grain transport.

sentences.zh: 四十年，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he was appointed first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he was appointed first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 尋授四川提督，遷兩廣總督。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed provincial commander of Sichuan and transferred to governor-general of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed provincial commander of Sichuan and then governor-general of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 卒，加太子太保銜，諡壯敏。

translations.literal: He died and was given the posthumous rank Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and the temple name Zhuangmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously given Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent rank and the temple name Zhuangmin.

sentences.zh: =溫福=溫福，字履綏，費莫氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人，文華殿大學士溫達孫也。

translations.literal: Wen Fu, style Lüshou, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner and grandson of Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory Wenda.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu, style Lüshou, of the Feimo clan, belonged to the Manchu Bordered Red Banner and was the grandson of Grand Secretary Wenda of the Hall of Literary Glory.

sentences.zh: 自繙譯舉人授兵部筆​​帖式。

translations.literal: From translator licentiate he was appointed clerk of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: From translator licentiate he was appointed a clerk of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，累遷戶部郎中。

translations.literal: In early Qianlong he was repeatedly transferred until he became director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong he rose through repeated promotions until he became a director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 外擢湖南布政使，歷四年；

translations.literal: He was promoted outside the capital to Hunan provincial treasurer and served four years;
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Hunan provincial treasurer and served four years;

sentences.zh: 移貴州布政使，亦四年。

translations.literal: transferred to Guizhou provincial treasurer, also for four years.
translations.idiomatic: then transferred to Guizhou provincial treasurer for another four years.

sentences.zh: 坐平遠民閧訟庭、按治草率，奪職，戍烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: He was punished because Pingyuan commoners rioted in the court and his investigation was perfunctory; his office was stripped and he was exiled to Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished because Pingyuan commoners rioted in court and his investigation was perfunctory; he was stripped of office and exiled to Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，起內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was recalled as Grand Secretariat reader.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was recalled as Grand Secretariat reader.

sentences.zh: 從定邊將軍兆惠討霍集占，戰葉爾羌，槍傷顴。

translations.literal: He followed Pacification General Zhaohui against Khoja Jahan, fought at Yarkand, and was wounded in the cheek by gunfire.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Pacification General Zhaohui against Khoja Jahan, fought at Yarkand, and was wounded in the cheek by gunfire.

sentences.zh: 擢內閣學士，遷倉場侍郎，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He was promoted Grand Secretariat academician, transferred to vice minister of the Granaries, and granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted Grand Secretariat academician, transferred to vice minister of the Granaries, and granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 外授福建巡撫，內遷吏部侍郎、軍機處行走，進理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: He was appointed outside the capital governor of Fujian, transferred within to vice minister of Personnel and assignment to the Grand Council, and advanced to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Fujian, recalled to serve as vice minister of Personnel and on the Grand Council, and advanced to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，師徵金川，授定邊右副將軍，以侍郎桂林佐之，共討賊。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year troops campaigned against Jinchuan; he was appointed Pacification Commissioner on the Right with Vice Minister Guilin as assistant to campaign against the rebels together.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year the army campaigned against Jinchuan; he was appointed Pacification Commissioner on the Right with Vice Minister Guilin as his deputy to campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 溫福自汶川出西路，桂林自打箭爐出南路。

translations.literal: Wen Fu marched out by the western route from Wenchuan; Guilin marched out by the southern route from Dajianlu.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu advanced by the western route from Wenchuan; Guilin advanced by the southern route from Dajianlu.

sentences.zh: 時小金川頭人澤旺子僧格桑割地乞援於大金川頭人索諾木，索諾木潛遣兵助之。

translations.literal: At this time Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Zewang's son Senggesang ceded territory to beg aid from Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu, who secretly sent troops to help him.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Zewang's son Senggesang ceded territory to beg aid from Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu, who secretly sent troops to assist him.

sentences.zh: 上命先剿小金​​川，且勿聲大金川罪。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that Lesser Jinchuan be suppressed first and that Greater Jinchuan's guilt not be proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that Lesser Jinchuan be suppressed first and that Greater Jinchuan's complicity not be proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 溫福至打箭爐，分兵三道入：溫福出巴朗拉，提督董天弼自甲金達援達木巴宗，總督阿爾泰自約咱攻僧格桑。

translations.literal: Wen Fu reached Dajianlu and divided the army into three columns: Wen Fu advanced by Balang La, provincial commander Dong Tianbi from Jajianda to relieve Damubazong, and governor Aertai from Yozai against Senggesang.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu reached Dajianlu and divided his forces into three columns: Wen Fu advanced by Balang La, provincial commander Dong Tianbi from Jajianda to relieve Damubazong, and governor Aertai from Yozai against Senggesang.

sentences.zh: 十一月，擢武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he was promoted grand secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was promoted grand secretary of the Hall of Military Glory.

sentences.zh: 十二月，至巴朗拉，戰三晝夜，賊敗去。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he reached Balang La, fought three days and nights, and the rebels were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he reached Balang La, fought for three days and nights, and the rebels were defeated and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 三十七年正月，取達木巴宗。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-seventh year Damubazong was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-seventh year Damubazong was captured.

sentences.zh: 進攻斯底葉安，而分軍出別斯滿、瑪爾瓦爾濟，兩路夾擊，進克資哩。

translations.literal: He advanced against Sidiye'an while dividing troops out by Biesiman and Ma'erwa'erji for a two-pronged attack and took Zili.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced against Sidiye'an while dividing troops through Biesiman and Ma'erwa'erji for a pincer attack and captured Zili.

sentences.zh: 再進克東瑪，再進克路頂宗及喀木色爾，取諸碉寨。

translations.literal: Advancing again he took Dongma, then Ludingzong and Kamuse'er, and seized the blockhouses and stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing again he captured Dongma, then Ludingzong and Kamuse'er, and seized the blockhouses and stockades.

sentences.zh: 再進得博爾根山梁，並攻克得瑪覺烏寨落，攻公雅山。

translations.literal: Advancing again he gained the Bo'ergen ridge, also took the Demajuewu stockades, and attacked Gongya Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing again he took the Bo'ergen ridge, also captured the Demajuewu stockades, and attacked Gongya Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十二月，授定邊將軍，以阿桂、豐升額副之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was appointed Pacification General with Agui and Fengsheng'e as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was appointed Pacification General with Agui and Fengsheng'e as deputies.

sentences.zh: 進克明郭宗，再進克底木達。

translations.literal: He advanced to take Mingguozong and again took Dimuda.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to capture Mingguozong and then Dimuda.

sentences.zh: 底木達者，僧格桑父澤旺所居寨也。

translations.literal: Dimuda was the stockade where Senggesang's father Zewang had resided.
translations.idiomatic: Dimuda was the stockade where Senggesang's father Zewang had lived.

sentences.zh: 師至，俘澤旺，檻致京師，誅於市，而僧格桑奔大金川。

translations.literal: When the army arrived, Zewang was captured, sent to the capital in a cage, and executed in the marketplace, while Senggesang fled to Greater Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: When the army arrived, Zewang was captured, sent to the capital in a cage, and executed in the marketplace, while Senggesang fled to Greater Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 溫福檄索諾木令縛獻僧格桑，不應。

translations.literal: Wen Fu ordered Suonuomu by proclamation to bind and deliver Senggesang; he did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu ordered Suonuomu by proclamation to bind and deliver Senggesang; he refused.

sentences.zh: 上將進討大金川，溫福等疏言：「前此張廣泗徵金川，十路、七路分合不常，實祗有六路，皆以抵勒烏圍、噶爾依為主。

translations.literal: The emperor was about to advance against Greater Jinchuan; Wen Fu and others memorialized: "When Zhang Guangsi campaigned against Jinchuan before, ten routes or seven routes were spoken of with shifting combinations—in fact there were only six routes, all aimed chiefly at reaching Lewuwei and Ga'eryi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was preparing to advance against Greater Jinchuan; Wen Fu and others memorialized: "When Zhang Guangsi campaigned against Jinchuan before, accounts spoke of ten or seven routes with shifting combinations—in fact there were only six routes, all aimed chiefly at Lewuwei and Ga'eryi.

sentences.zh: 一為卡撒正路，自美諾至噶爾依，約五程，為傅恆進兵路；

translations.literal: One was the main Kasai route from Meinuo to Ga'eryi, about five stages, the route by which Fu Heng advanced;
translations.idiomatic: One was the main Kasai route from Meinuo to Ga'eryi, about five stages—the route Fu Heng had used;

sentences.zh: 一為丹壩，自維州橋經番地抵勒烏圍，約二十餘程，中有穆津岡天險，為岳鍾琪進兵路；

translations.literal: one was Danba, from Weizhou Bridge through native territory to Lewuwei, about twenty-odd stages, with the heavenly barrier of Mujingang in between, the route by which Yue Zhongqi advanced;
translations.idiomatic: one was Danba, from Weizhou Bridge through native territory to Lewuwei, about twenty stages, with the natural barrier of Mujingang in between—the route Yue Zhongqi had used;

sentences.zh: 一地名僧格桑，自美諾抵噶爾依，六七程，即總兵馬良柱所行路；

translations.literal: one place was named Senggesang, from Meinuo to Ga'eryi, six or seven stages, the route taken by regional commander Ma Liangzhu;
translations.idiomatic: one route passed through a place named Senggesang, from Meinuo to Ga'eryi in six or seven stages—the route regional commander Ma Liangzhu had taken;

sentences.zh: 一為革布什咱，一為馬爾邦，皆距噶爾依六七程，險狹難行；

translations.literal: one was Gebushizan and one Ma'erbang, each six or seven stages from Ga'eryi, narrow and dangerous and hard to travel;
translations.idiomatic: one was Gebushizan and one Ma'erbang, each six or seven stages from Ga'eryi, narrow, dangerous, and hard to travel;

sentences.zh: 一為綽斯甲布寨至勒烏圍三程，至噶爾依亦三程，均隔大河，碉寨林立，難攻。

translations.literal: one was from Zhuosijia stockade to Lewuwei in three stages and to Ga'eryi also three stages, all separated by great rivers with blockhouses and stockades standing thick and hard to attack.
translations.idiomatic: one ran from Zhuosijia stockade to Lewuwei in three stages and to Ga'eryi in another three, all separated by great rivers with dense blockhouses and stockades that were hard to attack.

sentences.zh: 此外又有俄坡一路，從綽斯甲布寨至勒烏圍，僅二程，路較平。

translations.literal: Besides these there was also the Epo route from Zhuosijia stockade to Lewuwei, only two stages, with a comparatively level road.
translations.idiomatic: Besides these there was also the Epo route from Zhuosijia stockade to Lewuwei, only two stages, with a comparatively level road.

sentences.zh: 今當由卡撒正路進兵，其俄坡一路，既有綽斯甲布土司原出兵復其侵地，可為犄角。

translations.literal: Now the army should advance by the main Kasai route; on the Epo route the Zhuosijia chieftain is already sending troops to recover seized territory and can serve as a pincer.
translations.idiomatic: Now the army should advance by the main Kasai route; on the Epo route the Zhuosijia chieftain is already sending troops to recover seized territory and can serve as a supporting force.

sentences.zh: 其餘各路，分兵牽制，使不能兼顧。

translations.literal: On the remaining routes troops should be divided to pin down the enemy so they cannot attend to everything.
translations.idiomatic: On the remaining routes troops should be divided to pin down the enemy so they cannot defend everywhere at once.

sentences.zh: 」於是溫福自功噶爾拉入，阿桂自當噶爾拉入，豐升額自綽斯甲布入。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Wen Fu entered by Gongga'er La, Agui by Dangga'er La, and Fengsheng'e by Zhuosijia.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Wen Fu entered by Gongga'er La, Agui by Dangga'er La, and Fengsheng'e by Zhuosijia.

sentences.zh: 溫福性剛愎，不廣諮方略，惟襲訥親、張廣泗故事，以碉卡攻碉卡，修築千計。

translations.literal: Wen Fu was stubborn by nature, did not widely consult on strategy, and only followed the precedents of Neqin and Zhang Guangsi—attacking blockhouses with blockhouses and building by the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu was stubborn by nature, did not widely consult on strategy, and only followed the precedents of Neqin and Zhang Guangsi—attacking blockhouses with blockhouses and building thousands of fortifications.

sentences.zh: 所將兵二萬餘，強半散在各碉卡。

translations.literal: The troops he commanded numbered more than twenty thousand, more than half scattered among the various blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: The troops under his command numbered more than twenty thousand, more than half scattered among the various blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 每逾數日當奏事，即督兵攻碉。

translations.literal: Every few days when he should have reported affairs, he instead directed troops to attack blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Every few days when he should have reported to the throne, he instead directed troops to attack blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 士卒多傷亡，諮怨無鬥志。

translations.literal: Soldiers suffered many casualties, complained bitterly, and had no fighting spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers suffered heavy casualties, complained bitterly, and lost all fighting spirit.

sentences.zh: 溫福日置酒高會，參贊伍岱歎曰：「焉有為帥若此而能制勝者？

translations.literal: Wen Fu daily held grand banquets; staff officer Wu Dai sighed and said: "How can a commander like this ever win victory?
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu held grand banquets every day; staff officer Wu Dai sighed and said: "How can a commander like this ever win a victory?

sentences.zh: 」因密疏聞上，溫福亦疏劾伍岱。

translations.literal: " He therefore memorialized the emperor in secret; Wen Fu also memorialized to impeach Wu Dai.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore sent a secret memorial to the emperor; Wen Fu also memorialized to impeach Wu Dai.

sentences.zh: 上命豐升額及額駙色布騰巴勒珠爾按治。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Fengsheng'e and imperial son-in-law Sebuteng Balzhu'er to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Fengsheng'e and imperial son-in-law Sebuteng Balzhu'er to investigate the matter.

sentences.zh: 溫福又言色布騰巴勒珠爾朋比傾陷，上為奪伍岱職，令色布騰巴勒珠爾逮詣熱河行在，獄成，戍伍岱伊犁。

translations.literal: Wen Fu also said Sebuteng Balzhu'er had formed a faction to frame him; the emperor stripped Wu Dai of office, ordered Sebuteng Balzhu'er arrested and sent to the Rehe traveling palace; when the case was complete, Wu Dai was exiled to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu also claimed that Sebuteng Balzhu'er had formed a faction to frame him; the emperor stripped Wu Dai of office, ordered Sebuteng Balzhu'er arrested and sent to the Rehe traveling palace; when the case was concluded, Wu Dai was exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 三十八年春，溫福師至功噶爾拉，賊阻險，不得進，別取道攻昔嶺，駐軍木果木；

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year Wen Fu's army reached Gongga'er La; the rebels blocked the dangerous passes and he could not advance, so he took another route to attack Xiling and stationed troops at Muguo Wood;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year Wen Fu's army reached Gongga'er La; the rebels held the dangerous passes and he could not advance, so he took another route to attack Xiling and encamped at Muguo Wood;

sentences.zh: 令提督董天弼分軍屯底木達。

translations.literal: he ordered provincial commander Dong Tianbi to divide troops and garrison Dimuda.
translations.idiomatic: he ordered provincial commander Dong Tianbi to divide his forces and garrison Dimuda.

sentences.zh: 木果木、底木達皆故小金川地，索諾木陰使小金川頭人煽諸降番使復叛。

translations.literal: Muguo Wood and Dimuda were both former Lesser Jinchuan territory; Suonuomu secretly had Lesser Jinchuan chieftains incite the surrendered tribes to rebel again.
translations.idiomatic: Muguo Wood and Dimuda were both former Lesser Jinchuan territory; Suonuomu secretly had Lesser Jinchuan chieftains incite the surrendered tribes to rebel again.

sentences.zh: 諸降番以師久頓不進，遂蜂起應之。

translations.literal: The surrendered tribes, because the army had long halted without advancing, rose in swarms to answer the call.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered tribes, seeing the army stalled for so long without advancing, rose in swarms to join the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 先攻底木達，天弼死之，次劫糧台，潛襲木果木。

translations.literal: They first attacked Dimuda and Tianbi was killed; next they raided the grain depots and secretly struck Muguo Wood.
translations.idiomatic: They first attacked Dimuda and Tianbi was killed; next they raided the grain depots and launched a surprise attack on Muguo Wood.

sentences.zh: 溫福不嚴備山後要隘，賊突薄大營，奪砲局，斷汲道。

translations.literal: Wen Fu did not strictly guard the vital passes behind the mountains; the rebels suddenly pressed the great camp, seized the artillery park, and cut off the water route.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu failed to guard the vital passes in the rear; the rebels suddenly pressed the main camp, seized the artillery park, and cut off the water supply.

sentences.zh: 時大營兵尚萬餘，運糧役數千，爭避入大營，溫福堅閉壘門不納，轟而潰，聲如壞堤，於是軍心益震。

translations.literal: At the time the great camp still had more than ten thousand troops and several thousand transport laborers, all scrambling to flee into the camp; Wen Fu firmly closed the stockade gates and would not admit them; they collapsed in a roar like a broken dike, and army morale was shaken all the more.
translations.idiomatic: The main camp still held more than ten thousand troops and several thousand transport laborers, all scrambling to flee inside; Wen Fu firmly closed the stockade gates and refused them entry; they collapsed in a roar like a broken dike, and army morale collapsed with them.

sentences.zh: 賊四面蹂入，溫福中槍死，各卡兵望風潰散。

translations.literal: The rebels trampled in from all sides; Wen Fu was shot and died; troops at every post fled at the mere sight of them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels overran the camp from all sides; Wen Fu was shot and killed; troops at every post fled at the mere sight of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 參贊海蘭察聞警赴援，殿餘兵自間道出。

translations.literal: Staff officer Hailancha, hearing the alarm, went to relieve them and covered the retreat of the remaining troops out by a hidden route.
translations.idiomatic: Staff officer Hailancha, hearing the alarm, rushed to their aid and covered the retreat of the surviving troops along a hidden route.

sentences.zh: 小金川地盡陷。

translations.literal: Lesser Jinchuan territory fell entirely.
translations.idiomatic: All of Lesser Jinchuan territory was lost.

sentences.zh: 上初聞溫福死，詔予一等伯爵，世襲罔替，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: When the emperor first heard of Wen Fu's death, he decreed him a first-class earl with perpetual hereditary succession and enshrinement in the Temple of Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor first heard of Wen Fu's death, he decreed him a first-class earl with perpetual hereditary succession and enshrinement in the Temple of Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 既，劉秉恬、海蘭察、富勒渾各疏言溫福僨事狀，命奪伯爵，予三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: Afterward Liu Bingtian, Hailancha, and Fulehun each memorialized on Wen Fu's ruinous conduct; he was ordered stripped of the earldom and given the hereditary rank of third-class commandant of light chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Liu Bingtian, Hailancha, and Fulehun each memorialized on Wen Fu's disastrous conduct; he was stripped of the earldom and given the hereditary rank of third-class commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，命並罷之。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year he was ordered stripped of all honors.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year all honors were revoked.

sentences.zh: 子勒保、永保，皆有傳。

translations.literal: His sons Lebao and Yongbao each have biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Lebao and Yongbao each have biographies of their own.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：金川再亂，開泰、阿爾泰皆主以番攻番，遲回坐誤。

translations.literal: Commentary: When Jinchuan rebelled again, both Kai Tai and Aertai advocated letting natives fight natives, hesitating until opportunity was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: When Jinchuan rebelled again, both Kai Tai and Aertai advocated letting natives fight natives, hesitating until the moment for action was lost.

sentences.zh: 桂林有宋元俊不能用，反齮齕之，擁兵不進。

translations.literal: Guilin had Song Yuanjun but could not use him, instead bore him malice, and held troops without advancing.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin had Song Yuanjun at his disposal but would not use him, instead bore him malice, and held his troops back without advancing.

sentences.zh: 阿爾泰與元俊劾桂林，此其意以軍國為重，不屑屑阿貴近、疏卑遠，宜若可成功，乃坐蜚語敗。

translations.literal: Aertai and Yuanjun impeached Guilin with the intent of putting state and army first, disdaining to flatter the powerful and slight the humble and distant—one might think success assured, yet they were ruined by slander.
translations.idiomatic: Aertai and Yuanjun impeached Guilin with the intent of putting military affairs first, disdaining to flatter the powerful while slighting the humble—one might have expected success, yet they were ruined by slander.

sentences.zh: 溫福銳進，似勝開泰輩，乃又剛愎，有董天弼不能用，予兵至少，令僻處軍後，卒致僨潰，徒以身殉，豈不惜哉？

translations.literal: Wen Fu pressed forward boldly, seeming to surpass Kai Tai and his like, yet he was also stubborn; he had Dong Tianbi but could not use him, gave him too few troops, and posted him in a remote rear position—at last causing total collapse and dying for nothing alone. Is it not lamentable?
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu pressed forward boldly, seeming to surpass Kai Tai and his like, yet he was also stubborn; he had Dong Tianbi but would not use him, gave him too few troops, and posted him in a remote rear position—at last bringing on total collapse and dying alone for nothing. Is it not lamentable?
